questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the summer vacation, Mina worked at a bakery.
questions.why: 뒤에 the summer vacation이라는 명사구가 왔으므로 전치사 During이 알맞다. While·Because·Although·Though는 모두 「주어+동사」 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ I was waiting for the bus, it began to rain.
questions.why: 뒤에 I was waiting이라는 절이 왔으므로 접속사 While이 알맞다. During·Despite·Because of·In spite of는 모두 뒤에 명사(구)가 와야 하는 전치사(구)다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The road was closed ____ the heavy snow.
questions.why: the heavy snow는 명사구이므로 전치사 because of를 쓴다. because·although·while·though는 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ it was raining, we finished the game.
questions.why: it was raining이라는 절 앞이므로 양보의 접속사 Although가 알맞다. Despite·In spite of·During·Because of는 전치사(구)라 절을 이끌 수 없다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ his injury, Daniel finished the race.
questions.why: his injury는 명사구이므로 '~에도 불구하고'의 전치사 Despite를 쓴다. Although·Though·Even though·While은 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
We lost the match ____ we practiced hard.
questions.why: we practiced hard라는 절이 이어지고 '열심히 연습했지만'이라는 양보의 뜻이므로 접속사 although가 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 전치사(구)다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
Sujin fell asleep ____ the movie.
questions.why: the movie라는 명사구 앞이므로 '~ 동안'을 뜻하는 전치사 during을 쓴다. while·because·although·though는 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The flight was delayed ____ the storm.
questions.why: the storm은 명사구이므로 이유를 나타내는 전치사구 because of가 알맞다. because는 뒤에 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the concert, everyone stood up and sang. (콘서트 동안)
questions.why: '콘서트 동안'이라는 뜻이고 뒤에 명사구가 왔으므로 During이 알맞다. Despite도 전치사지만 '~에도 불구하고'라는 뜻이라 우리말과 맞지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
Nobody spoke ____ the teacher was talking.
questions.why: the teacher was talking은 절이므로 접속사 while이 필요하다. during·because of·despite·in spite of는 모두 명사(구)를 취하는 전치사(구)다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the heavy traffic, we arrived on time. (교통 체증에도 불구하고)
questions.why: 명사구 the heavy traffic 앞이면서 '~에도 불구하고'의 뜻이므로 Despite가 알맞다. Because of는 형태는 되지만 '교통 체증 때문에 제시간에 도착했다'가 되어 뜻이 어긋난다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
Tom couldn't sleep ____ the noise outside.
questions.why: the noise outside는 명사구이므로 because of를 쓴다. because는 「주어+동사」 절을 이끈다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ she was tired, she kept studying.
questions.why: 절 앞에서 '~이지만'의 뜻을 나타내는 접속사는 Although이다. 나머지는 모두 명사(구)를 취하는 전치사(구)다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
I met my old friend ____ my trip to Busan.
questions.why: my trip to Busan은 명사구이므로 '~ 동안'의 전치사 during을 쓴다. while은 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the test was easy, many students made mistakes.
questions.why: the test was easy라는 절 앞이고 '쉬웠지만'의 뜻이므로 접속사 Although가 알맞다. 나머지 넷은 전치사(구)라서 절을 이끌 수 없다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
We stayed inside ____ it was too hot outside.
questions.why: it was too hot outside는 절이므로 이유의 접속사 because를 쓴다. because of는 명사(구)만 취한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The baby cried ____ the whole flight.
questions.why: the whole flight는 명사구이므로 during이 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the bad weather, the picnic was canceled.
questions.why: the bad weather라는 명사구 앞이고 '나쁜 날씨 때문에'라는 이유의 뜻이므로 Because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
Please be quiet ____ the exam is going on.
questions.why: the exam is going on은 절이므로 접속사 while을 쓴다. during 뒤에는 the exam 같은 명사(구)만 올 수 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ her age, my grandmother runs every morning.
questions.why: her age는 명사구이고 '나이에도 불구하고'라는 뜻이므로 전치사 Despite가 알맞다. 나머지는 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) the concert, my phone rang.
• We went home early ____(B) it started to snow.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 the concert 앞이므로 During, (B)는 절 it started to snow 앞이므로 접속사 because가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) she felt sick, Mina went to school.
• The game was stopped ____(B) the rain.
questions.why: (A)는 절 앞이므로 접속사 Although, (B)는 명사구 the rain 앞이므로 because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• I read three books ____(A) the winter break.
• ____(B) the long line, we waited for an hour.
questions.why: (A)·(B) 모두 뒤에 명사구가 있으므로 전치사 during과 Because of를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) his hard work, he failed the audition.
• ____(B) I was cooking, the doorbell rang.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 his hard work 앞의 양보이므로 Despite, (B)는 절 앞이므로 접속사 While이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• The store closed early ____(A) the holiday.
• ____(B) it was expensive, she bought the coat.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 the holiday 앞이므로 because of, (B)는 절 앞의 양보이므로 Although가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• Don't use your phone ____(A) you are driving.
• He passed the test ____(B) his careful preparation.
questions.why: (A)는 절 you are driving 앞이므로 while, (B)는 명사구 앞이므로 because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) the heavy rain, the road was flooded.
• ____(B) the road was flooded, we took another way.
questions.why: (A) 뒤에는 명사구, (B) 뒤에는 절이 있으므로 각각 전치사 Because of와 접속사 Because를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• We talked a lot ____(A) lunch.
• ____(B) we talked a lot, I felt much better.
questions.why: (A)는 명사 lunch 앞이므로 during, (B)는 절 앞이므로 접속사 Because가 알맞다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: During I was young, I lived in Daegu.
Despite it was late, he called me.
Although his kindness, I was still upset.
While the movie, I fell asleep.
Because of the rain, the game was stopped.
questions.why: Because of 뒤에 명사구 the rain이 와서 옳다. During·Despite 뒤에는 절이 올 수 없고, Although·While 뒤에는 명사구가 올 수 없다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: During he was sleeping, the phone rang.
We stayed home because of the snow.
While she was cooking, I set the table.
Despite the noise, he slept well.
Although he was sick, he came to school.
questions.why: During은 전치사이므로 뒤에 절이 올 수 없다. During he was sleeping은 While he was sleeping으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장은?
choices: Despite of the cold, we walked to school.
Despite the cold, we walked to school.
In spite the cold, we walked to school.
Although the cold, we walked to school.
Because the cold, we walked to school.
questions.why: despite는 그 자체가 전치사여서 of를 붙이지 않으므로 Despite the cold가 옳다. in spite of는 of가 반드시 필요하고, Although·Because 뒤에는 명사구가 아니라 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
choices: I slept while we were traveling.
I slept because I was tired.
questions.why: while은 접속사이므로 명사구 the trip을 바로 취할 수 없다. during the trip으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳은 것은?
choices: The class ended early because the fire drill.
The class ended early during the fire drill was held.
The class ended early despite the fire drill was held.
The class ended early because of the fire drill.
The class ended early although the fire drill.
questions.why: because of 뒤에 명사구 the fire drill이 와서 옳다. because·although 뒤에는 절이, during·despite 뒤에는 명사구가 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
choices: Despite her fear, she went on stage.
Although she was afraid, she went on stage.
In spite of her fear, she went on stage.
Even though she was afraid, she went on stage.
Despite she was afraid, she went on stage.
questions.why: Despite는 전치사라 절을 이끌 수 없다. Despite she was afraid는 Although she was afraid 또는 Despite her fear로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것은?
choices: The power went out during the storm.
While the storm, the power went out.
During the storm hit the town, we hid.
The power went out while the storm.
The power went out because the storm.
questions.why: during 뒤에 명사구 the storm이 와서 옳다. 나머지는 전치사와 접속사의 자리를 바꿔 쓴 문장이다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
choices: He was late because of the traffic jam.
He was late because of there was a traffic jam.
He was late because there was a traffic jam.
He was late due to the traffic jam.
He was late because the road was blocked.
questions.why: because of 뒤에는 명사(구)만 올 수 있다. because of there was ~는 because there was ~로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
폭우 때문에 소풍이 취소되었다.
choices: The picnic was canceled because the heavy rain.
The picnic was canceled although the heavy rain.
The picnic was canceled because of the heavy rain.
The picnic was canceled during the heavy rain fell.
The picnic was canceled despite the heavy rain.
questions.why: 명사구 the heavy rain 앞에는 이유의 전치사구 because of를 쓴다. despite는 '~에도 불구하고'라 우리말과 뜻이 반대이고, because·although 뒤에는 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

choices: I didn't say a word while dinner.
I didn't say a word because of dinner.
I didn't say a word despite dinner.
I didn't say a word during dinner.
I didn't say a word although dinner.
questions.why: 명사 dinner 앞에서 '~ 동안'을 뜻하는 전치사는 during이다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

choices: Despite he was young, he was very brave.
During he was young, he was very brave.
Because he was young, he was very brave.
In spite of he was young, he was very brave.
Although he was young, he was very brave.
questions.why: '~이지만'의 양보를 나타내면서 절을 이끄는 접속사는 Although이다. Despite·During·In spite of 뒤에는 절이 올 수 없고, Because는 뜻이 어긋난다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그의 노력에도 불구하고 그는 그 일자리를 얻지 못했다.

Although his effort, he didn't get the job.
Because of his effort, he didn't get the job.
Despite he made an effort, he didn't get the job.
During his effort, he didn't get the job.
questions.why: 명사구 his effort 앞에서 '~에도 불구하고'를 나타내는 전치사는 Despite이다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
내가 설거지를 하는 동안 그녀는 방을 청소했다.
choices: During I was doing the dishes, she cleaned the room.
While I was doing the dishes, she cleaned the room.

During my doing the dishes, she cleaned the room.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?

choices: Because of we were late, we took a taxi.
Although we were late, we took a taxi.
Because we were late, we took a taxi.
During we were late, we took a taxi.
Despite we were late, we took a taxi.
questions.why: 절 앞에서 이유를 나타내는 접속사는 Because이다. Because of 뒤에는 명사(구)만 온다.

B: I stayed home ____ a bad cold.
questions.why: a bad cold는 명사구이므로 because of를 쓴다.

다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

questions.why: 명사구 the long flight 앞에서 '~에도 불구하고'를 뜻하는 전치사는 Despite이다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

questions.why: the winter vacation은 명사구이므로 '~ 동안'의 전치사 during이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: Can I call you right now?
B: Sorry, not ____ I'm in class.
questions.why: I'm in class는 절이므로 접속사 while을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?

questions.why: 두 빈칸 모두 뒤에 명사구가 오고 이유를 나타내므로 because of가 공통으로 들어간다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• ____ the parade, the streets were full of people.

questions.why: 두 빈칸 모두 뒤에 명사구가 오고 '~ 동안'의 뜻이므로 during이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(Because / Because of) the thick fog, the ferry did not leave.
questions.why: the thick fog는 명사구이므로 전치사구 Because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(Although / Despite) the high price, he bought the bike.
questions.why: the high price는 명사구이므로 전치사 Despite를 쓴다. Although는 절을 이끈다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(While / During) my parents were out, I cooked dinner.
questions.why: my parents were out은 절이므로 접속사 While을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(Because / Because of) I forgot my password, I couldn't log in.
questions.why: I forgot my password는 절이므로 접속사 Because가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(Although / Despite) she was nervous, she sang very well.
questions.why: she was nervous는 절이므로 접속사 Although를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
Kevin didn't say anything (during / while) the meal.
questions.why: the meal은 명사구이므로 전치사 during이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(In spite of / Even though) the traffic, they arrived early.
questions.why: the traffic은 명사구이므로 전치사구 In spite of를 쓴다. Even though는 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
The lights went out (because / because of) a power failure.
questions.why: a power failure는 명사구이므로 because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(While / During) I was reading, my sister was drawing.
questions.why: I was reading은 절이므로 접속사 While을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>During</u> I was cleaning my room, I found an old photo.
questions.why: 뒤에 절이 이어지므로 전치사 During을 접속사 While로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
The concert was postponed <u>because</u> the singer's illness.
questions.why: the singer's illness는 명사구이므로 because를 because of로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>Despite</u> he practiced every day, he lost the game.
questions.why: 뒤에 절이 오므로 전치사 Despite를 양보의 접속사 Although(Though, Even though)로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
The students didn't speak <u>during</u> the teacher was explaining the rule.
questions.why: the teacher was explaining은 절이므로 during을 접속사 while로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>Because of</u> the bus was late, I missed the first class.
questions.why: the bus was late는 절이므로 Because of를 접속사 Because로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>Although</u> the heavy rain, the festival went on as planned.
questions.why: the heavy rain은 명사구이므로 접속사 Although를 전치사 Despite(In spite of)로 고친다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 표현을 이용하여 밑줄 친 부분을 전치사구로 바꿔 문장 전체를 다시 쓰시오.
<u>Because it snowed heavily</u>, the flight was canceled. (the heavy snow)
questions.answer: Because of the heavy snow, the flight was canceled.
alt: because of the heavy snow, the flight was canceled.
questions.why: 절을 명사구로 바꾸면 접속사 Because는 전치사구 Because of가 되어야 한다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 표현을 이용하여 밑줄 친 부분을 전치사구로 바꿔 문장 전체를 다시 쓰시오.
<u>While I was staying in London</u>, I visited many museums. (my stay in London)
questions.answer: During my stay in London, I visited many museums.
alt: during my stay in London, I visited many museums.
questions.why: 명사구 my stay in London 앞에서는 접속사 While 대신 전치사 During을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 표현을 이용하여 밑줄 친 부분을 전치사구로 바꿔 문장 전체를 다시 쓰시오.
<u>Although the room was small</u>, it felt very cozy. (its small size)
questions.answer: Despite its small size, it felt very cozy.
alt: despite its small size, it felt very cozy.
In spite of its small size, it felt very cozy.
in spite of its small size, it felt very cozy.
questions.why: 명사구 앞에서는 양보의 접속사 Although 대신 전치사 Despite(In spite of)를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안의 절을 이용하여 밑줄 친 부분을 절로 바꿔 문장 전체를 다시 쓰시오.
<u>During the meeting</u>, nobody asked a question. (the meeting was going on)
questions.answer: While the meeting was going on, nobody asked a question.
alt: while the meeting was going on, nobody asked a question.
questions.why: 절 앞에서는 전치사 During 대신 접속사 While을 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the rapid increase in online shopping, many small bookstores have closed.
questions.why: 뒤에 명사구가 왔고 이유를 나타내므로 Because of가 알맞다. Although·Because·While은 접속사, Despite는 뜻이 반대다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The library stayed open ____ the renovation was going on.
questions.why: the renovation was going on은 절이므로 접속사 while을 쓴다. 나머지는 모두 명사(구)를 취하는 전치사(구)다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ heavy investment in advertising, the company's sales did not improve.
questions.why: heavy investment in advertising은 명사구이고 '~에도 불구하고'의 뜻이므로 Despite가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
Several passengers dozed off ____ the two-hour flight.
questions.why: the two-hour flight는 특정 기간을 나타내는 명사구이므로 during을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the company lost money last year, it hired even more workers.
questions.why: 뒤에 절이 오고 양보의 뜻이므로 접속사 Even though가 알맞다. 나머지 넷은 전치사(구)다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The rocket launch was postponed ____ technical problems.
questions.why: technical problems는 명사구이므로 이유의 전치사구 due to가 알맞다. 나머지는 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
We finished the project on time ____ everyone's help.
questions.why: everyone's help는 명사구이므로 '~ 덕분에'를 뜻하는 전치사구 thanks to를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ some people enjoy horror movies, others cannot watch them at all. (~인 반면에)
questions.why: 뒤에 절이 오고 '~인 반면에'라는 대조의 뜻이므로 접속사 While이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The bridge remained closed ____ three months after the flood.
questions.why: three months처럼 기간의 '길이'를 나타내는 말 앞에는 for를 쓴다. during은 the vacation처럼 특정 기간을 가리키는 명사 앞에 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the earthquake, thousands of people lost their homes overnight.
questions.why: the earthquake는 명사구이고 이유를 나타내므로 Because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The runner kept smiling ____ the sharp pain in his knee.
questions.why: the sharp pain in his knee는 명사구이므로 전치사 despite를 쓴다. although·even though·while·because는 절을 이끈다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ I was reviewing the report, my manager called me twice.
questions.why: I was reviewing the report는 절이므로 접속사 While이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The team won the final ____ their best player was injured.
questions.why: 뒤에 절이 오고 양보의 뜻이므로 접속사 even though를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the fact that he had been warned twice, he kept driving too fast.
questions.why: the fact that ~는 명사구이므로 전치사 Despite를 쓴다. despite the fact that은 '~라는 사실에도 불구하고'라는 굳은 표현이다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) the storm damaged the roof, the shop opened as usual.
• The repairs took two weeks ____(B) the shortage of workers.
questions.why: (A) 뒤에는 절이 있으므로 접속사 Although, (B) 뒤에는 명사구가 있으므로 because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• Traffic was heavy ____(A) the morning rush hour.
• ____(B) the traffic was heavy, we still got there early.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 앞이므로 during, (B)는 절 앞의 양보이므로 Although가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) his lack of experience, Mr. Park was chosen as team leader.
• The members trusted him ____(B) he listened to everyone carefully.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 his lack of experience 앞이므로 Despite, (B)는 절 앞이므로 because가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• The power went out ____(A) a lightning strike.
• ____(B) the lights were off, the students kept working.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 앞이므로 전치사구 owing to, (B)는 절 앞의 양보이므로 Even though가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• Nobody left the hall ____(A) the award ceremony.
• ____(B) the speech was long, the audience listened quietly.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 the award ceremony 앞이므로 during, (B)는 절 앞의 양보이므로 Although가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) the concert was going on, no one was allowed to enter.
• The doors stayed closed ____(B) safety rules.
questions.why: (A)는 절 앞이므로 While, (B)는 명사구 safety rules 앞이므로 because of가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>Although</u> the long delay, the passengers stayed calm, and ②<u>during</u> the wait the crew ③<u>offered</u> free drinks ④<u>because</u> the airline wanted to ⑤<u>apologize</u>.
questions.why: the long delay는 명사구이므로 접속사 Although가 아니라 전치사 Despite를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
The museum closed early ①<u>because of</u> a power failure, and ②<u>while</u> the repairs were being made, visitors ③<u>waited</u> outside ④<u>despite</u> it was raining ⑤<u>heavily</u>.
questions.why: despite는 전치사라 it was raining 같은 절을 이끌 수 없다. although(though)로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
The interview went well ①<u>because of</u> Mina's careful preparation, and ②<u>during</u> the panel asked hard questions, she ③<u>stayed</u> calm ④<u>despite</u> her nervousness ⑤<u>throughout</u> the meeting.
questions.why: the panel asked hard questions는 절이므로 during이 아니라 접속사 while을 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
The team practiced ①<u>during</u> six months, and ②<u>although</u> they lost the final, the fans ③<u>cheered</u> ④<u>because of</u> the players' effort ⑤<u>and</u> team spirit.
questions.why: six months는 기간의 길이이므로 during이 아니라 for를 써야 한다. during은 the season처럼 특정 기간을 가리키는 명사 앞에 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
The village was quiet ①<u>during</u> the festival week, and ②<u>although</u> many tourists came, the streets ③<u>remained</u> clean ④<u>because of</u> the volunteers who worked ⑤<u>despite</u> it rained every day.
questions.why: it rained every day는 절이므로 despite가 아니라 though(although)를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Many plants died ①<u>because of</u> the sudden frost, and ②<u>although</u> the gardener covered them, ③<u>during</u> the temperature dropped again, the leaves ④<u>turned</u> brown ⑤<u>overnight</u>.
questions.why: the temperature dropped again은 절이므로 during이 아니라 접속사 when(while)을 써야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장은?
choices: Due to the road was icy, the bus was late.
Because of the road was icy, the bus was late.
Although the icy road, the bus was late.
During the road was icy, the bus was late.
Owing to the icy road, the bus was late.
questions.why: owing to는 전치사구여서 명사구 the icy road를 취할 수 있다. Due to·Because of·During 뒤에는 절이 올 수 없고, Although 뒤에는 명사구가 아니라 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은?
choices: Thanks to you helped me, I made the right choice.
Thanks to your advice, I made the right choice.
Because your advice was helpful, I made the right choice.
Despite your advice, I made the wrong choice.
Although you advised me, I made the wrong choice.
questions.why: thanks to는 전치사구이므로 뒤에 절이 올 수 없다. Thanks to your help로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바른 것은?
choices: While the negotiation, both sides stayed calm.
During the long negotiation, both sides stayed calm.
During the negotiation lasted, both sides stayed calm.
Despite the negotiation was long, both sides stayed calm.
Because of the negotiation was long, both sides stayed calm.
questions.why: During 뒤에 명사구 the long negotiation이 와서 옳다. 나머지는 모두 전치사 뒤에 절이 오거나 접속사 뒤에 명사구가 왔다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: In spite of the criticism, the director kept his plan.
Even though he was criticized, the director kept his plan.
Despite of the criticism, the director kept his plan.
Despite being criticized, the director kept his plan.
Although the critics disagreed, the director kept his plan.
questions.why: despite는 그 자체가 전치사이므로 of를 붙이지 않는다. Despite the criticism 또는 In spite of the criticism이 옳다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바른 문장은?
choices: The match was stopped because heavy rain.
The match was stopped although heavy rain.
The match was stopped during it rained heavily.
The match was stopped because of heavy rain.
The match was stopped despite it rained heavily.
questions.why: because of 뒤에 명사구 heavy rain이 와서 옳다. because·although 뒤에는 절이, during·despite 뒤에는 명사구가 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳지 않은 문장은?
choices: I read two novels during the flight.
I read two novels while I was flying.
I read two novels because I was bored.
I read two novels despite the engine noise.
I read two novels during I was flying.
questions.why: during 뒤에는 명사(구)만 올 수 있으므로 during I was flying은 while I was flying으로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 것은?
choices: Despite his efforts, the plan failed in the end.
Although his efforts, the plan failed in the end.
Because of he tried hard, the plan failed in the end.
During he tried hard, the plan failed in the end.
In spite his efforts, the plan failed in the end.
questions.why: 명사구 his efforts 앞에는 전치사 Despite를 쓴다. in spite of는 of를 빠뜨릴 수 없고, Although 뒤에는 절이, Because of·During 뒤에는 명사구가 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 잘못된 것은?
choices: While I was in Jeju, I went hiking every day.
I went hiking during five days.
During my stay in Jeju, I went hiking every day.
I stayed in Jeju for five days.
Despite the strong wind, I went hiking.
questions.why: five days는 기간의 길이이므로 during이 아니라 for를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
짙은 안개 때문에 우리는 산 정상을 볼 수 없었다.
choices: Because the thick fog, we couldn't see the top of the mountain.
Although the thick fog, we couldn't see the top of the mountain.
Because of the thick fog, we couldn't see the top of the mountain.
Despite the thick fog, we couldn't see the top of the mountain.
During the fog was thick, we couldn't see the top of the mountain.
questions.why: 명사구 the thick fog 앞에서 이유를 나타내는 표현은 Because of이다. Despite는 뜻이 반대다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 회의가 진행되는 동안 아무도 방을 나가지 않았다.
choices: During the meeting was going on, nobody left the room.
Despite the meeting was going on, nobody left the room.
Because of the meeting was going on, nobody left the room.
While the meeting was going on, nobody left the room.
While the meeting, nobody left the room.
questions.why: the meeting was going on이라는 절 앞에는 접속사 While을 쓴다. While the meeting처럼 접속사 뒤에 명사구만 오거나 During·Despite·Because of 뒤에 절이 오면 틀린다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그의 나이에도 불구하고 그는 마라톤을 완주했다.
choices: Although his age, he finished the marathon.
Despite of his age, he finished the marathon.
In spite his age, he finished the marathon.
During his age, he finished the marathon.
Despite his age, he finished the marathon.
questions.why: 명사구 his age 앞의 양보 표현은 Despite(=In spite of)이며 despite에는 of를 붙이지 않는다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
교통사고 때문에 그 도로는 두 시간 동안 폐쇄되었다.
choices: The road was closed for two hours because of a traffic accident.
The road was closed during two hours because of a traffic accident.
The road was closed for two hours because a traffic accident.
The road was closed for two hours due to a traffic accident happened.
The road was closed while two hours because of a traffic accident.
questions.why: 기간의 길이 two hours 앞에는 for를, 명사구 a traffic accident 앞에는 because of를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
비록 그 책이 어렵지만, 그것은 읽을 가치가 있다.
choices: Despite the book is difficult, it is worth reading.
Even though the book is difficult, it is worth reading.
In spite of the book is difficult, it is worth reading.
Despite of the difficult book, it is worth reading.
During the book is difficult, it is worth reading.
questions.why: the book is difficult는 절이므로 양보의 접속사 Even though를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: You look really tired today.
B: I stayed up all night ____ my final report.
questions.why: my final report는 명사구이므로 because of를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
A: How was the science museum?
B: Great. ____ we had only an hour, we saw almost everything.
questions.why: we had only an hour는 절이므로 양보의 접속사 Although가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• The flight was delayed ____ engine trouble.
• The ceremony was postponed ____ the mayor's absence.
questions.why: 두 빈칸 모두 명사구를 취하면서 이유를 나타내야 하므로 전치사구 due to가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• ____ the exam, students may not use their phones.
• The mountain road is icy ____ the winter months.
questions.why: 두 빈칸 모두 특정 기간을 나타내는 명사구 앞이므로 during이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ㄱ. Despite the cold weather, the market was crowded.
ㄴ. While the parade, the streets were closed.
ㄷ. Because of a mistake in the schedule, we missed the train.
ㄹ. Although his warning, they went ahead.
ㅁ. During the summer, the shop opens at seven.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅁ은 전치사 뒤에 명사구가 와서 옳다. ㄴ은 While → During, ㄹ은 Although → Despite로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ㄱ. The concert began late due to a sound problem.
ㄴ. Even though the rain, the parade continued.
ㄷ. While she was speaking, everyone took notes.
ㄹ. Despite of his talent, he was not selected.
ㅁ. Because of the ice was thin, we did not skate.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄷ만 옳다. ㄴ은 Even though → Despite, ㄹ은 Despite of → Despite, ㅁ은 Because of → Because로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ㄱ. Thanks to the volunteers, the beach was clean again.
ㄴ. During the storm lasted, we stayed in the basement.
ㄷ. In spite of the warning, they swam in the river.
ㄹ. Although the museum was free, few people visited it.
ㅁ. The library closed early because of the national holiday.
questions.why: ㄴ만 틀렸다. the storm lasted는 절이므로 During을 While로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(Owing to / Even though) the sudden change of plan, we had to book a new hotel.
questions.why: the sudden change of plan은 명사구이므로 전치사구 Owing to가 알맞다. Even though는 절을 이끄는 접속사다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
The players kept training (despite / although) the extreme heat.
questions.why: the extreme heat는 명사구이므로 전치사 despite를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
Sales grew steadily (while / during) the last three quarters.
questions.why: the last three quarters는 특정 기간을 가리키는 명사구이므로 during이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(While / During) the negotiations continued, both companies said nothing.
questions.why: the negotiations continued는 절이므로 접속사 While을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
The city museum has been closed (for / during) six weeks.
questions.why: six weeks는 기간의 길이이므로 for를 쓴다. during은 the holidays처럼 특정 기간 명사 앞에 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(Even though / In spite of) she had never skated before, she won a medal.
questions.why: she had never skated before는 절이므로 접속사 Even though가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
The delivery was delayed (because / because of) a mechanical problem.
questions.why: a mechanical problem은 명사구이므로 because of를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
괄호 안에서 어법상 알맞은 것을 골라 쓰시오.
(Despite / Although) the report was long, everyone read it carefully.
questions.why: the report was long은 절이므로 접속사 Although를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>Despite of</u> the heavy snow, the mail was delivered on time.
questions.why: despite는 전치사 자체이므로 of를 붙이지 않는다. Despite 또는 In spite of로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
The children played outside <u>during</u> the sun was shining.
questions.why: the sun was shining은 절이므로 during을 접속사 while(when)으로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>Because of</u> she had a high fever, Sora stayed home from school.
questions.why: she had a high fever는 절이므로 Because of를 접속사 Because로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
The small company survived <u>although</u> the long economic crisis.
questions.why: the long economic crisis는 명사구이므로 접속사 although를 전치사 despite(in spite of)로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
The rescue team waited at the gate <u>during</u> two hours.
questions.why: two hours는 기간의 길이이므로 during이 아니라 for를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (because를 그대로 이용할 것)
The road was cleared quickly <u>because</u> the volunteers' hard work.
questions.why: the volunteers' hard work는 명사구이므로 접속사 because를 전치사구 because of로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Although the traffic was terrible, we arrived on time.
= ____ the terrible traffic, we arrived on time. (D로 시작하는 한 단어)
questions.why: 절이 명사구로 바뀌었으므로 접속사 Although 대신 전치사 Despite를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Because there was a strike, the trains stopped running.
= ____ the strike, the trains stopped running. (because로 시작하는 두 단어)
questions.why: 명사구 the strike 앞에서는 접속사 Because를 전치사구 Because of로 바꿔야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
While I was staying in Rome, I learned some Italian.
= ____ my stay in Rome, I learned some Italian. (D로 시작하는 한 단어)
questions.why: 명사구 my stay in Rome 앞에서는 접속사 While 대신 전치사 During을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
In spite of his poor eyesight, he passed the pilot test.
= ____ his eyesight was poor, he passed the pilot test. (A로 시작하는 한 단어)
questions.why: 명사구가 절로 바뀌었으므로 전치사구 In spite of 대신 양보의 접속사 Although를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Due to the sudden power cut, the show ended early.
= ____ the power was suddenly cut, the show ended early. (B로 시작하는 한 단어)
questions.why: 명사구가 절로 바뀌었으므로 전치사구 Due to 대신 이유의 접속사 Because를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
During the flight, the crew served two meals.
= ____ the plane was flying, the crew served two meals. (W로 시작하는 한 단어)
questions.why: 명사구가 절로 바뀌었으므로 전치사 During 대신 접속사 While을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. Despite the fact that the data were incomplete, the committee approved the plan.
ㄴ. While the survey was being conducted, several respondents withdrew.
ㄷ. Because of the results were inconclusive, the study was repeated.
questions.why: ㄱ은 despite the fact that+절, ㄴ은 while+절로 옳다. ㄷ은 뒤에 절이 왔으므로 Because of를 Because로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. Owing to a sharp fall in demand, the factory shortened its working hours.
ㄴ. Although its heavy losses, the airline kept every route open.
ㄷ. During the first quarter, exports rose by nearly ten percent.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄷ은 전치사(구) 뒤에 명사구가 와서 옳다. ㄴ은 접속사 Although 뒤에 명사구가 왔으므로 Despite로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. In spite of he was warned repeatedly, the driver ignored the signal.
ㄴ. Even though the machine was old, it worked without a single error.
ㄷ. The concert was delayed due to a problem with the sound system.
questions.why: ㄴ은 접속사+절, ㄷ은 전치사구+명사구로 옳다. ㄱ은 In spite of 뒤에 절이 왔으므로 Although로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. While some economists predict a recovery, others expect a further decline.
ㄴ. Thanks to the new filter, the water quickly became safe to drink.
ㄷ. Despite the temperature dropped below zero, the race went on.
questions.why: ㄱ의 While은 '~인 반면에'의 접속사, ㄴ의 Thanks to는 명사구를 취하는 전치사구로 옳다. ㄷ은 Despite 뒤에 절이 와서 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. The team stayed in the shelter during the entire night.
ㄴ. The team stayed in the shelter during eight hours.
ㄷ. The team stayed in the shelter while the storm passed over the valley.
questions.why: ㄴ의 eight hours는 기간의 길이이므로 during이 아니라 for를 써야 한다. ㄱ은 특정 기간 명사구, ㄷ은 절이므로 각각 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. Despite of the risks involved, the surgeon performed the operation.
ㄴ. Because the risks were high, the surgeon explained everything twice.
ㄷ. The operation succeeded because of the surgeon's long experience.
questions.why: despite에는 of를 붙이지 않으므로 ㄱ은 틀렸다. ㄴ은 because+절, ㄷ은 because of+명사구로 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. During the interview, the candidate answered every question calmly.
ㄴ. Despite the interview lasted two hours, nobody complained.
ㄷ. He got the job because of his careful preparation.
questions.why: ㄴ은 Despite 뒤에 절이 왔으므로 Although로 고쳐야 한다. ㄱ·ㄷ은 전치사 뒤에 명사구가 와서 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. Despite the fact that he had little training, he completed the climb.
ㄴ. He kept climbing even though his hands were almost frozen.
ㄷ. He reached the summit thanks to his partner's steady support.
questions.why: ㄱ의 despite the fact that, ㄴ의 even though는 절을, ㄷ의 thanks to는 명사구를 취하므로 셋 다 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. While the drought, farmers lost most of their crops.
ㄴ. Because of the drought lasted for months, food prices rose sharply.
ㄷ. In spite of the drought, some farmers still harvested enough rice.
questions.why: ㄱ은 While → During, ㄴ은 Because of → Because로 고쳐야 한다. ㄷ만 전치사구 뒤에 명사구가 와서 옳다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것을 모두 고른 것은?
ㄱ. Owing to the fact that the bridge was unsafe, the city closed it.
ㄴ. The city closed the bridge although the heavy traffic on it.
ㄷ. Drivers complained loudly while the repairs were being carried out.
questions.why: ㄴ은 접속사 although 뒤에 명사구가 왔으므로 despite로 고쳐야 한다. ㄱ의 owing to the fact that과 ㄷ의 while은 모두 절을 이끌 수 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>Although</u> researchers had collected data for years, the pattern remained unclear ②<u>until</u> a new model appeared; ③<u>despite</u> the model was remarkably simple, it explained ④<u>most of</u> the results ⑤<u>at once</u>.
questions.why: despite는 전치사이므로 the model was remarkably simple이라는 절을 이끌 수 없다. although(though)로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>During</u> the long negotiation, neither side gave in, and ②<u>because of</u> the deadlock, the deadline ③<u>was extended</u> twice ④<u>in spite</u> the growing pressure from ⑤<u>investors</u>.
questions.why: '~에도 불구하고'의 전치사구는 in spite of이므로 of가 빠진 in spite는 틀렸다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
The vaccine program succeeded ①<u>thanks to</u> the cooperation of local clinics, and ②<u>while</u> supplies were limited at first, deliveries ③<u>improved</u> sharply ④<u>because</u> the arrival of extra trucks ⑤<u>from</u> the capital.
questions.why: the arrival of extra trucks는 명사구이므로 접속사 because가 아니라 because of를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>Despite</u> repeated warnings from the weather service, hundreds of hikers entered the park, and ②<u>during</u> the storm hit the ridge, rangers ③<u>had to</u> rescue ④<u>more than</u> forty people ⑤<u>in spite of</u> the darkness.
questions.why: the storm hit the ridge는 절이므로 during이 아니라 when(while)을 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
The old theater survived ①<u>because of</u> a generous donation, and ②<u>although</u> the building was over a century old, it reopened ③<u>while</u> the summer festival ④<u>with</u> a new stage ⑤<u>and</u> modern lighting.
questions.why: the summer festival은 명사구이므로 접속사 while이 아니라 전치사 during을 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>Owing to</u> a sudden drop in temperature, the pipes froze overnight, and ②<u>because</u> the water supply was cut, residents ③<u>were asked</u> to stay indoors ④<u>during</u> two days ⑤<u>until</u> repairs were finished.
questions.why: two days는 기간의 길이이므로 during이 아니라 for를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>While</u> the committee reviewed the proposal, the mayor remained silent, but ②<u>despite of</u> his silence, reporters ③<u>assumed</u> that he supported it ④<u>because of</u> his earlier remarks ⑤<u>on</u> the subject.
questions.why: despite는 그 자체가 전치사이므로 of를 붙일 수 없다. despite 또는 in spite of로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
Traffic in the city center fell sharply ①<u>after</u> the new fee was introduced, and ②<u>even though</u> shop owners protested, sales actually rose ③<u>during</u> the following months ④<u>thanks to</u> the cleaner air ⑤<u>although</u> the higher parking costs.
questions.why: the higher parking costs는 명사구이므로 접속사 although가 아니라 despite(in spite of)를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>Because of</u> the museum wanted to attract younger visitors, it opened a digital gallery, and ②<u>while</u> older members complained at first, attendance ③<u>doubled</u> ④<u>during</u> the first year ⑤<u>thanks to</u> wide media coverage.
questions.why: the museum wanted ~는 절이므로 Because of가 아니라 접속사 Because를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 틀린 것은?
①<u>In spite of</u> the heavy rain that fell all week, the marathon took place as planned, and ②<u>although</u> the punishing last five kilometers, most runners kept going ③<u>because</u> the crowd cheered them on ④<u>despite</u> the cold wind ⑤<u>from</u> the sea.
questions.why: the punishing last five kilometers는 명사구이므로 접속사 although가 아니라 despite(in spite of)를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The city council approved the plan ____ strong opposition from local residents.
questions.why: strong opposition ~은 명사구이므로 전치사구 in spite of가 알맞다. despite the fact that은 뒤에 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the fact that the software was completely free, very few people downloaded it.
questions.why: the fact that절은 명사구이므로 전치사 Despite를 쓴다. Owing to도 명사구를 취하지만 '무료였기 때문에 아무도 안 받았다'가 되어 뜻이 어긋난다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
Global average temperatures rose steadily ____ the twentieth century.
questions.why: the twentieth century는 특정 기간을 가리키는 명사구이므로 during이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ digital maps are far more convenient, many hikers still carry paper ones. (~인 반면에)
questions.why: 뒤에 절이 오고 대조를 나타내므로 접속사 While이 알맞다. 나머지는 모두 명사(구)를 취하는 전치사(구)다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ his repeated apologies, the audience refused to forgive the comedian.
questions.why: his repeated apologies는 명사구이고 양보의 뜻이므로 전치사 Despite가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
The negotiations finally broke down ____ neither side was willing to compromise.
questions.why: neither side was willing ~은 절이므로 접속사 because를 쓴다. 나머지는 명사(구)만 취한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
____ the exhibition was open to the public, photography inside the hall was strictly forbidden.
questions.why: the exhibition was open ~은 절이므로 접속사 While이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 어법상 알맞은 것은?
Ticket sales nearly doubled ____ the final week of the exhibition.
questions.why: the final week of the exhibition은 특정 기간 명사구이므로 during을 쓴다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법에 맞는 문장은?
choices: Although the storm warning, the ferry left the port.
Because of the storm warning was issued, the ferry stayed.
During the storm warning was issued, the ferry stayed.
In spite the storm warning, the ferry left the port.
Despite the storm warning, the ferry left the port.
questions.why: 명사구 the storm warning 앞에는 전치사 Despite를 쓴다. In spite는 of가 빠졌고, Although 뒤에는 절이, Because of·During 뒤에는 명사구가 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 잘못된 문장은?
choices: The experiment failed due to a small calculation error was made.
The experiment failed owing to a small calculation error.
The experiment failed because a small calculation error had been made.
The experiment failed due to a small calculation error.
The experiment failed because of a small calculation error.
questions.why: due to는 전치사구이므로 뒤에 절이 올 수 없다. due to a small calculation error로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳게 쓰인 것은?
choices: While the recession, unemployment rose sharply.
Unemployment rose sharply during the recession.
During unemployment rose sharply, the recession continued.
Unemployment rose sharply while the recession.
Unemployment rose sharply because the recession.
questions.why: during 뒤에 명사구 the recession이 와서 옳다. 나머지는 전치사와 접속사의 자리가 뒤바뀐 문장이다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 옳지 않은 것은?
choices: Despite having little sleep, she gave a brilliant presentation.
In spite of having little sleep, she gave a brilliant presentation.
Despite she had little sleep, she gave a brilliant presentation.
Although she had little sleep, she gave a brilliant presentation.
Even though she had little sleep, she gave a brilliant presentation.
questions.why: Despite 뒤에는 명사(구)나 동명사가 와야 하므로 Despite she had little sleep이 틀렸다. Although(Even though)를 쓰거나 Despite having ~으로 바꿔야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 옳게 쓰인 문장은?
choices: Thanks to the roads were repaired, the trip took only two hours.
The trip took only two hours thanks to the roads were repaired.
The trip took only two hours because of the roads were repaired.
The trip took only two hours thanks to the repaired roads.
The trip took only two hours although the repaired roads.
questions.why: thanks to 뒤에 명사구 the repaired roads가 와서 옳다. thanks to·because of 뒤에 절이 오거나 although 뒤에 명사구가 오면 틀린다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 것은?
choices: Prices remained stable throughout the crisis.
Prices remained stable during the crisis.
Prices remained stable while the crisis lasted.
Prices remained stable despite the crisis.
Prices remained stable during the crisis lasted.
questions.why: during 뒤에는 명사(구)만 올 수 있으므로 the crisis lasted라는 절을 이끌 수 없다. while로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 문장 중 어법상 알맞은 것은?
choices: Owing to his serious illness, the lecture was canceled.
Owing to he was seriously ill, the lecture was canceled.
Owing his serious illness, the lecture was canceled.
Owing to that he was seriously ill, the lecture was canceled.
Although his serious illness, the lecture was canceled.
questions.why: owing to는 명사구를 취하는 전치사구이므로 Owing to his serious illness가 옳다. 절을 쓰려면 owing to the fact that he was ill로 써야 하고, Although 뒤에는 절이 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 중 어법상 바르지 않은 문장은?
choices: The store stayed open for twelve hours.
The store stayed open during twelve hours.
The store stayed open during the holidays.
The store stayed open while the fair was on.
The store stayed open despite the storm.
questions.why: twelve hours는 기간의 길이이므로 during이 아니라 for를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) the heavy fog, the airport suspended all flights.
• ____(B) passengers waited in the terminal, the crew rested.
• Some flights resumed ____(C) the fog finally lifted.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구, (B)·(C)는 절이 이어지므로 각각 Because of, While, because가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) its small size, the device stores a huge amount of data.
• ____(B) you are traveling, you can charge it with a solar panel.
• The battery lasts ____(C) three days.
questions.why: (A)는 명사구 앞의 양보이므로 Despite, (B)는 절 앞이므로 While, (C)는 기간의 길이이므로 for가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• The concert was rescheduled ____(A) the singer's sudden illness.
• ____(B) the long delay, all the tickets were sold again.
• Fans waited outside ____(C) the box office was closed.
questions.why: (A)·(B)는 명사구 앞이므로 due to와 Despite, (C)는 절 앞이므로 while이 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) heavy rain had fallen for days, the river did not flood.
• Engineers had strengthened the banks ____(B) the previous summer.
• The city stayed safe ____(C) their careful planning.
questions.why: (A)는 절 앞이므로 Although, (B)는 특정 기간 명사구 앞이므로 during, (C)는 명사구 앞의 '~ 덕분에'이므로 thanks to가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 짝지어진 것은?
• ____(A) the strike lasted three weeks, the newspaper was printed every day.
• Reporters worked from home ____(B) the whole period.
• Readers hardly noticed anything ____(C) the smooth planning.
choices: In spite of … during … owing to
questions.why: (A)는 절 앞이므로 Even though, (B)는 the whole period라는 명사구 앞이므로 while이 아닌 during, (C)는 명사구 앞의 이유 표현 owing to가 알맞다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
폭설에도 불구하고 구조대는 예정된 시간에 도착했다.
choices: Although the heavy snowfall, the rescue team arrived on schedule.
Despite of the heavy snowfall, the rescue team arrived on schedule.
Despite the heavy snowfall, the rescue team arrived on schedule.
In spite the heavy snowfall, the rescue team arrived on schedule.
Because of the heavy snowfall, the rescue team arrived on schedule.
questions.why: 명사구 the heavy snowfall 앞의 양보 표현은 Despite이며 of를 붙이지 않는다. Because of는 뜻이 반대이고, Although 뒤에는 절이 와야 하며 In spite에는 of가 필요하다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
회의가 진행되는 동안 그 문제가 여러 번 언급되었지만, 아무 결정도 내려지지 않았다.
choices: During the meeting was going on, the issue was mentioned several times, but no decision was made.
Despite the meeting was going on, the issue was mentioned several times, but no decision was made.
While the meeting, the issue was mentioned several times, but no decision was made.
While the meeting was going on, the issue was mentioned several times, but no decision was made.
Because of the meeting was going on, the issue was mentioned several times, but no decision was made.
questions.why: the meeting was going on은 절이므로 접속사 While을 써야 한다. While the meeting처럼 접속사 뒤에 명사구만 오거나 During·Despite·Because of 뒤에 절이 오면 틀린다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것은?
그 지역의 물 부족 때문에 정부는 3개월 동안 물 사용을 제한했다.
choices: Because the water shortage in the area, the government limited water use for three months.
Because of the water shortage in the area, the government limited water use during three months.
Despite the water shortage in the area, the government limited water use for three months.
Because of the water shortage in the area, the government limited water use while three months.
Because of the water shortage in the area, the government limited water use for three months.
questions.why: 명사구 앞에는 Because of를, 기간의 길이 three months 앞에는 for를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ㄱ. Despite the fact that the road was closed, the delivery arrived on time.
ㄴ. Owing to the engine failed, the ship returned to port.
ㄷ. While the guests were arriving, the chef prepared the sauce.
ㄹ. The concert lasted during three hours.
ㅁ. Thanks to a quick response, the fire caused little damage.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄷ·ㅁ이 옳다. ㄴ은 Owing to 뒤에 절이 왔고, ㄹ은 during three hours를 for three hours로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 개수는?
ㄱ. In spite of the warnings, the climbers continued to the summit.
ㄴ. Because the loud music, we could not hear each other at all.
ㄷ. During the rehearsal lasted, the stage lights suddenly went out.
ㄹ. Although the equipment was old, the recording came out clear.
ㅁ. Despite the technicians worked all night, the problem remained.
questions.why: ㄱ·ㄹ만 옳다. ㄴ은 Because → Because of, ㄷ은 During → While, ㅁ은 Despite → Although로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>Despite</u> the committee had approved the budget, the project never started.
questions.why: the committee had approved ~는 절이므로 전치사 Despite를 양보의 접속사 Although(Though)로 고친다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (b로 시작하는 한 단어)
The rescue was delayed <u>owing to</u> the helicopter could not land on the ridge.
questions.why: the helicopter could not land ~는 절이므로 전치사구 owing to를 이유의 접속사 because로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
The exhibition ran <u>during</u> eleven weeks without a single day off.
questions.why: eleven weeks는 기간의 길이이므로 during이 아니라 for를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
<u>In spite</u> the enormous cost, the city decided to build a second library.
questions.why: '~에도 불구하고'의 전치사구는 in spite of이므로 of를 빠뜨릴 수 없다. Despite로 바꿔도 된다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오.
Online sales rose sharply <u>while</u> the year-end holiday season.
questions.why: the year-end holiday season은 명사구이므로 접속사 while이 아니라 전치사 during을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 고쳐 쓰시오. (because를 그대로 이용할 것)
<u>Because</u> the shortage of skilled workers, the factory could not expand.
questions.why: the shortage of skilled workers는 명사구이므로 접속사 Because를 전치사구 Because of로 고쳐야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Although the machine was extremely old, it never broke down.
= Despite ____, it never broke down. (its, extreme, age를 모두 이용하여 세 단어로)
questions.why: 전치사 Despite 뒤에는 명사구가 와야 하므로 절 the machine was extremely old를 its extreme age로 바꾼다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Because the roads were covered with ice, the school buses did not run.
= ____ the icy roads, the school buses did not run. (b로 시작하는 두 단어)
questions.why: 명사구 the icy roads 앞에서는 접속사 Because 대신 전치사구 Because of를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
During his stay in Berlin, he wrote three short novels.
= ____ Berlin, he wrote three short novels. (다섯 단어)
questions.why: 명사구 his stay in Berlin을 절로 바꾸면 전치사 During 대신 접속사 While을 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
In spite of the noise from the street, the baby slept soundly.
= ____ the street was noisy, the baby slept soundly. (A로 시작하는 한 단어)
questions.why: 명사구가 절로 바뀌었으므로 전치사구 In spite of 대신 양보의 접속사 Although를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Owing to the sudden cancellation of the flight, we spent the night at the airport.
= ____ the flight was suddenly canceled, we spent the night at the airport. (B로 시작하는 한 단어)
questions.why: 명사구가 절로 바뀌었으므로 전치사구 Owing to 대신 이유의 접속사 Because를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
The concert was excellent although the sound system was poor.
= The concert was excellent ____ system. (despite와 poor를 이용하여 네 단어로)
questions.why: 절을 명사구 the poor sound system으로 바꾸면 접속사 although 대신 전치사 despite를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장이 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
While the fire was burning, firefighters evacuated the whole building.
= ____, firefighters evacuated the whole building. (During과 fire를 이용하여 세 단어로)
questions.why: 절이 명사구 the fire로 바뀌었으므로 접속사 While 대신 전치사 During을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 표현을 모두 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오. (어형은 그대로 쓸 것)
짙은 안개 때문에 그 배는 항구를 떠날 수 없었다. (because of로 시작할 것)
(because of / the thick fog / the ship / could not leave / the port)
questions.answer: Because of the thick fog, the ship could not leave the port.
alt: Because of the thick fog the ship could not leave the port.
questions.why: 명사구 the thick fog 앞에는 접속사 because가 아니라 전치사구 because of를 써야 한다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 표현을 모두 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오. (어형은 그대로 쓸 것)
그의 경험 부족에도 불구하고 그는 그 팀을 이끌도록 선택되었다. (despite로 시작할 것)
(despite / his lack of experience / he / was chosen / to lead the team)
questions.answer: Despite his lack of experience, he was chosen to lead the team.
alt: Despite his lack of experience he was chosen to lead the team.
questions.why: 명사구 his lack of experience 앞에는 양보의 전치사 despite를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 표현을 모두 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오. (어형은 그대로 쓸 것)
회의가 진행되는 동안 아무도 휴대전화를 사용하지 않았다. (while로 시작할 것)
(while / the meeting / was going on / nobody / used a cell phone)
questions.answer: While the meeting was going on, nobody used a cell phone.
alt: While the meeting was going on nobody used a cell phone.
questions.why: the meeting was going on은 절이므로 during이 아니라 접속사 while을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 표현을 모두 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오. (어형은 그대로 쓸 것)
그 상점은 겨울 세일 기간 동안 매일 문을 열었다. (the shop으로 시작할 것)
(the shop / opened / every day / during / the winter sale)
questions.answer: The shop opened every day during the winter sale.
alt: the shop opened every day during the winter sale.
questions.why: the winter sale은 특정 기간을 가리키는 명사구이므로 while이 아니라 during을 쓴다.

questions.stem:
우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 괄호 안의 표현을 모두 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오. (어형은 그대로 쓸 것)
비록 표가 비쌌지만 그 공연장은 꽉 찼다. (even though로 시작할 것)
(even though / the tickets / were expensive / the hall / was full)
questions.answer: Even though the tickets were expensive, the hall was full.
alt: Even though the tickets were expensive the hall was full.
questions.why: the tickets were expensive는 절이므로 despite가 아니라 접속사 even though를 쓴다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 한 단어를 쓰시오.
• ____ the rainy season, this narrow road is often flooded.
• The stone temple was built ____ the fifteenth century.
questions.why: 두 빈칸 모두 특정 기간을 나타내는 명사구 앞이므로 전치사 during이 공통으로 들어간다.

questions.stem:
다음 두 문장의 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 한 단어를 쓰시오.
• ____ she was cooking dinner, the power suddenly went out.
• ____ some students prefer online classes, others learn better in person.
questions.why: 두 빈칸 모두 뒤에 절이 오며 각각 '~하는 동안', '~인 반면에'의 뜻이므로 접속사 While이 공통으로 들어간다.
